1.why: The guard at test.sh:601 only checks AGENT_QUALITY_GATE_LOCK_HELD and GITHUB_ACTIONS, so a lock-free gate run (--no-lock or AGENT_QUALITY_GATE_LOCK=0) can still honor a focus. That is the known defect 'test.sh:628 Reject focus during lock-free gate runs'.

2.why: In verify_gate_family_partition, the awk skips every line before the '# >>> gate family body start' marker (the `body == 0 { previous = $0; next }` rule), so it only checks lines inside and after the body. A test placed among the helpers above line 656 is never flagged, which contradicts the unqualified 'reds the suite when a test line sits outside every family' in the docs at lines 1146-1150. The code comment itself limits the check to lines 'between the body markers'.
